entities.summary: Kendra Suzanne Horn is an American politician and lawyer who served as the U.S. representative for Oklahoma's 5th congressional district from 2019 to 2021. A member of the Democratic Party, her district included the vast majority of Oklahoma City. Horn is to date the last Democrat to represent Oklahoma in Congress.
